csv_scope_of_work: It is the intention of the University of South Carolina to select a Construction Manager at Risk (CM-R) to provide comprehensive pre-construction and construction services for the Strom Thurmond Wellness and Fitness Center Renovation ( Project ). The University of South Carolina seeks a Construction Manager-at-Risk (CM-R) to provide comprehensive preconstruction and construction services for the renovation of the Strom Thurmond Wellness & Fitness Center, including planning, cost estimating, scheduling, value engineering, subcontractor management, GMP development, construction coordination, and project closeout services.
